messages:
maria: Heads-up — ran the nightly link-scan and spotted a couple of dead anchors and one stale external gist in the runtime quickstart and onboarding pages. Can someone grab small fixes?

maria: files: https://internal.redwood/docs/runtime/quickstart.md#kv-cache and https://internal.redwood/docs/onboarding/sdk-usage.md (the gist link 404s).

jonathan: I can take the runtime quickstart anchor. quick check: do we want to redirect the old fragment or just update the heading to match the anchor? :thinking_face:

maria: prefer updating the heading to keep canonical URLs stable. tiny PR is fine. if you change the heading, add a short redirect entry in docs-redirects.yaml so old links don't break.

sam: I can rehost the gist content and update the onboarding snippet. will upload to our internal snippets bucket and swap the URL.

luis: pinging @docs-codeowners for a quick review once PRs are up. also, can we add a test to the docs-ci link-check step to catch this anchor mismatch?

jonathan: opening PR now — small rename of the h3 and added a redirect entry. PR: https://git.internal.redwood/p/docs/PR-4127 (will drop a link here when CI runs).

docs-bot: link-scan: 2 dead anchors detected in docs runtime and onboarding (9412345678). Suggested actions: update heading, rehost external asset.

maria: thanks all. jonathan, if CI flags anything, @sam can follow up with the snippet rehost. no need for a long review — 1 maintainer approval should be enough.

sam: uploaded gist to s3://redwood-docs-snippets/onboarding/gist-2026-03-21.md and updated the URL in the PR diff.

jonathan: CI is green on the docs build, leaving a short PR description and changelog line. requesting review from @luis. :shipit:

luis: reviewing now, will merge after a quick sanity check. also creating a jira-lite ticket to add a unit for anchor consistency in docs-ci.

maria: perfect. leaving a note in the runtime runbook to reference the new heading (so oncall searches match). thanks everyone for the quick weekend pickup :raised_hands:
